public_body: Granby Housing Authority Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the apartment visit involved no quorum, and the brief legal-matter exchange fell within the warrant topic. An unspecific added allegation was declined.

allegations.summary: Board members allegedly deliberated while visiting apartments under construction before the July 22 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: As such, we find that the Board did not improperly deliberate as alleged where a quorum of the Board was not present at the visit and there has been no allegation or suggestion that deliberation occurred via serial communication.

allegations.summary: A brief discussion of a legal matter during the July 22 meeting allegedly went beyond the posted topic 'Warrant Report.'
allegations.key_passage: We find that the brief exchange regarding the legal matter naturally flowed from the Board’s consideration of the notice topic related to the warrant and therefore the notice was sufficient to inform the public of the discussion that occurred.

allegations.summary: A chair comment was said to show further deliberation outside an open meeting; the AG treated it as a possible added allegation.
allegations.key_passage: To the extent the above comment was intended as an additional allegation, we decline to review it where it is not sufficiently specific and does not present evidence that a violation of the Open Meeting Law may have occurred.
